blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Search is a central component of Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems and has been deeply investigated for classical ASR modeling based on Hidden Markov Models (HMMs). However, in work on current sequence-to-sequence ASR architectures it is often simplified to a small fixed-size beam search without external Language Model (LM). In this work, we present a comparative analysis of search space complexity and efficiency for Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) and neural transducer models under different pruning strategies and LM configurations. We show that these end-to-end (E2E) models work with a small search space most of the time but exhibit large temporary peaks in hypothesis count during periods of uncertainty. Score-based pruning dynamically adapts the search to model uncertainty, leading to a significantly lower Real-Time Factor (RTF). Our results highlight the limitations of search with low fixed-size beam pruning and provide practical guidelines for efficient search in E2E ASR.
blocks.zh: 搜索是自动语音识别(ASR)系统的核心组成部分,对于基于Hide Markov Models(HMMM)的经典ASR模型,已经进行了深入的调查. 然而,在目前序列到序列的ASR架构的作品中,往往被简化为没有外部语言模型(LM)的小型固定大小束搜索. 在这项工作中,我们根据不同的推力战略和LM配置,对连接器时间分类(CTC)和神经传导器模型的搜索空间复杂性和效率进行了比较分析。 我们显示,这些端对端(E2E)模型在大部分时间都与一个小的搜索空间一起工作,但在不确定时期的假说计数中却表现出了很大的临时峰值. 基于分数的奔跑动态地将搜索调整为模型不确定性,导致实时因子(RTF)显著降低. 我们的成果突出了使用低固定尺寸光束进行搜索的局限性,并为在E2E ASR中高效搜索提供了实用指南.

blocks.en: I Introduction & Related Work
blocks.zh: 一. 导言和有关工作

blocks.en:
Search (or decoding) is the central process that brings together the components of an ASR system in order to turn acoustic evidence into a transcription by navigating a space of intermediate hypotheses over time.
In the large vocabulary continuous speech recognition (LVCSR) era of the 1990s-2000s, search spaces often contained thousands or tens of thousands of hypotheses per time step, which drove the need for efficient search strategies and methods for search space reduction [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] .
Modern neural ASR models such as CTC [ 5 ] , neural transducers [ 6 ] and Attention Encoder-Decoder (AED) [ 7 ] models have changed this setting.
They often exhibit sharp posterior distributions where most of the time the probability mass is concentrated on only one output class [ 8 ] .
Additionally, these models are commonly defined on an orthographic (e.g. character or Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) [ 9 ] ) rather than a phonetic subword vocabulary, making search possible without a pronunciation lexicon or external LM .
Due to this development, more sophisticated search methods have been largely disregarded in recent literature, and many works just report fixed beam-sizes of 1-8 without external LM integration.
Dynamic score-threshold pruning and lexical prefix-tree based search organization are known techniques from classical ASR , but their practical role for modern time-synchronous E2E architectures has been underrepresented.
blocks.zh:
搜索(或解码)是将一个ASR系统的组件集合在一起的中心过程,以便通过在一段时间内导航一个中间假说空间来将声学证据转化为一个转录.
在20世纪90至2000年代的大型词汇连续语音识别(LVCSR)时代,搜索空间往往每个时间段包含上千或上万个假说,这驱使需要高效的搜索策略和方法来减少搜索空间[1,2,3,4].
现代神经ASR模型如CTC [5],神经传导器 [6]和注意编码器-Decoder (AED) [7] 模型改变了这种设置.
它们经常表现出尖锐的后发分布,其中概率质量大部分集中在一个输出类上[8].
此外,这些模型通常被定义在一个正字法上(如字符或字节编码(BPE)[9]),而不是一个有口音的子词词汇上,这样就可以在没有发音词典或外部LM的情况下进行搜索.
由于这一发展,更复杂的搜索方法在近代文献中基本上被忽略了,许多作品只是报告固定的光束尺寸为1-8而未外部LM集成.
动态得分阈值活泼和词典前缀-树基搜索组织是古典ASR的已知技术,但其在现代时间同步E2E架构中的实际作用一直代表性不足.

blocks.en:
Most publicly available toolkits reflect this shift of focus away from search and only offer limited search capabilities for modern model architectures.
Flashlight [ 10 ] offers lexicon-constrained and lexicon-free search as well as word- and subword-level LM integration, but separate pruning of within-word and word-end hypotheses is not possible and it does not provide support for transducer models.
ESPnet [ 11 ] provides transducer search with neural LMs at the subword-level but does not provide lexicon- or word-level capabilities and only fixed-size beam pruning instead of dynamic score-based pruning.
k2/icefall [ 12 ] also offers many options for CTC search, including a lexicon and n-gram LM but only implements neural LMs via rescoring and again lacks dynamic pruning based on a score threshold for transducer search.
NeMo [ 13 ] and recent publications with it [ 14 , 15 , 16 ] aim to optimize the transducer search process fully on GPU in order to take advantage of parallelization and avoid inter-device communication.
However, this approach again prohibits word-level processing and dynamic pruning.
blocks.zh:
大多数可公开使用的工具包反映了重点从搜索转移的这种转变,只能为现代模型架构提供有限的搜索能力.
Flashlight [10] 提供了受词汇约束和无词汇搜索以及词和子词级的LM集成,但无法对词内和词尾假说进行单独浏览,也没有为转录器模型提供支持.
ESPnet [11]在子词级别上提供有神经LMs的转录器搜索,但不提供词典-或词级能力,只提供固定大小的光束穿行而不用动态分数穿行.
k2/icefall [12] 还为CTC搜索提供了许多选项,包括一个词典和正克LM,但仅通过再评分执行神经LMs,而且再次缺乏基于分数阈值的动态回推器搜索.
NeMo [13] 及其相伴的近期出版物[14,15,16]旨在将转录器搜索过程完全优化到GPU上,以利用并行性并避免互通.
然而,这种方法再次禁止文字级处理和动态穿行.

blocks.en:
In this paper, we challenge the assumption that small fixed-size beam search is sufficient for optimal performance with modern model architectures, in terms of both accuracy and speed.
In our open-source toolkit RASR [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] 1 1 1 https://github.com/rwth-i6/rasr we implemented a generic search module which supports various search strategies for various E2E ASR models, allowing a comprehensive study of their behavior and search space under comparable conditions.
We restrict the analysis in this work to time-synchronous CTC and monotonic transducer models because AED , Speech- Large Language Model (LLM) and related sequence-to-sequence models search label-synchronously which means that hypotheses at one search step may correspond to different input positions and finished hypotheses may have different lengths.
This makes active-hypothesis-count and pruning statistics not directly comparable and introduces the length-normalization problem which is out of scope for this discussion.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们质疑一个假设,即从准确性和速度两方面来说,小的固定尺寸光束搜索就足以与现代模型架构进行最佳性能.
在我们的开源工具包RASR [17, 18, 19] 1 1 1 https://github.com/rwth-i6/rasr 我们执行了一个通用搜索模块,支持各种E2E ASR模型的各种搜索策略,允许在可比条件下全面研究它们的行为和搜索空间.
我们把这项工作的分析限制在时间同步的CTC和单调转录器模型上,因为AED,Speech-Lige Language Model(LLM)和相关测序-序列模型搜索标签-同步,这意味着一个搜索步骤上的假设可能与不同的输入位置对应,完成的假设可能具有不同的长度.
这使得活性假说计数和推算统计不具有直接可比性,并引入了超出本次讨论范围的长度正常化问题.

blocks.en: The main contributions of our work are as follows: • We systematically compare the performance of BPE and phoneme-based CTC and neural transducer models under various search conditions such as with and without lexicon-constraint as well as with and without subword- or word-level LMs . • We analyze search space behavior across different models and task difficulty levels by computing search errors and hypothesis counts. • We quantify the impact of dynamic vs. fixed-size beam pruning on the search accuracy ( Word Error Rate (WER) ) and efficiency ( RTF ) across datasets and search conditions. • We give compact algorithmic descriptions and tuned decoding parameters for reproducibility. Our setups are published on GitHub 2 2 2 https://github.com/rwth-i6/returnn-experiments/tree/master/2026-search-space .
blocks.zh: 我们工作的主要贡献如下: 我们系统地比较在各种搜索条件下的BPE和基于电话的CTC和神经导出器模型的性能,例如有无词汇约束,以及有无子词或词级LM。 我们通过计算搜索错误和假设计数,分析不同模型的搜索空间行为和任务难度水平. ^ 我们量化动态对固定大小束穿行对搜索精度(Word Error rate (WER))和效率(RTF)跨数据集和搜索条件的影响. ^ 我们给出了紧凑的算法描述,并调制了可复制的解码参数. 我们的设置发表在 GitHub 2 2 https://github.com/rwth-i6/return- experiments/tree/master/2026-search-space上.

During the search process, we apply score-based and max-beam-size-based pruning strategies.
In score-based pruning with a threshold Δ \Delta , the current best hypothesis is selected from the beam and all hypotheses whose score (i.e., negative log probability) is worse than the current best plus the threshold are pruned.
Let ℋ \mathcal{H} be the current set of hypotheses, then this is formalized as: ScorePrune ​ ( ℋ , Δ ) = { q ∈ ℋ ∣ score ⁡ ( q ) ≤ min q ′ ∈ ℋ ⁡ { score ⁡ ( q ′ ) } + Δ } \textsc{ScorePrune}(\mathcal{H},\Delta)=\Big\{q\in\mathcal{H}\mid{}\mathrm{score}(q)\leq\min_{q^{\prime}\in\mathcal{H}}\{\mathrm{score}(q^{\prime})\}+\Delta\Big\} (5) On the other hand, with max-beam-size pruning, we simply keep a fixed maximum amount B B of hypotheses while pruning away the rest, i.e.: BeamPrune ​ ( ℋ , B ) = Top B ​ ( ℋ ) \textsc{BeamPrune}(\mathcal{H},B)=\mathrm{Top}_{B}(\mathcal{H}) (6)

blocks.en:
Pure fixed-beam search disables ScorePrune and only applies BeamPrune .
In our search implementation, we apply score- and max-beam-size-pruning with the option to use different thresholds after each individual score contribution, i.e., first after score ASR \mathrm{score}_{\mathrm{ASR}} , then after score SubLM \mathrm{score}_{\mathrm{SubLM}} and finally after score WordLM \mathrm{score}_{\mathrm{WordLM}} .
We also prune within-word hypotheses separately from word-end hypotheses.
We denote the ASR-stage, subword- LM and word- LM maximum beam sizes by B ASR B_{\mathrm{ASR}} , B SubLM B_{\mathrm{SubLM}} and B WordLM B_{\mathrm{WordLM}} , and their score thresholds by Δ ASR \Delta_{\mathrm{ASR}} , Δ SubLM \Delta_{\mathrm{SubLM}} and Δ WordLM \Delta_{\mathrm{WordLM}} , respectively.

blocks.en:
All decoding experiments use RASR as the implementation framework.
It supports, among others, CTC and transducer scorers, subword- and word-level LMs , lexicon-free and lexicon-constrained decoding, and the staged pruning described above. Algorithms 1 and 2 summarize the corresponding search steps implementations, but omit some optimizations such as on-the-fly extension pruning.
Notably, all results characterize the model and search procedure, not RASR-specific behavior.
blocks.zh:
所有解码实验都使用RASR作为执行框架.
它除其他外,支持CTC和转录器计分器、分词和单词级的LM、无词和受词典约束的解码,以及上文所述的相接分数。 算法 1 和 2 概括了相应的搜索步骤执行,但省略了一些优化,如"飞"上扩展普跑.
值得注意的是,所有结果都是模型和搜索程序的特点,而不是RASR特有的行为.

blocks.en: III Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 三. 实验设置

blocks.en:
Experiments are conducted on three corpora: LibriSpeech, Loquacious, and an in-house Spanish telephony corpus.
LibriSpeech [ 23 ] uses the full 960h training set and is evaluated on dev-other and test-other.
For Loquacious, we use the public medium portion with 2500h of 16kHz training data [ 24 ] .
Loquacious evaluation is performed on dev.all and test.all, which aggregate VoxPopuli, LibriSpeech, YODAS, and Common Voice.
The Spanish corpus contains around 12000h of 8kHz telephony training data and is evaluated on an in-house 4.5h test set, providing a harder-domain cross-lingual condition.
blocks.zh:
对三个公司进行了实验:LibriSpeech、Loquacus和一家内部的西班牙电话公司。
LibriSpeech [23] 使用完整的960h训练集,并被评价为dev-other和test-other.
对于Loquacious,我们使用公有的中段,拥有16kHz的2500h训练数据[24].
对Dev.all和test.all都进行了广泛的评价,这些评价汇总了VoxPopuli、LibriSpeech、YODS和Common Voice。
西班牙教程包含约12,000小时的8kHz电话培训数据,并经过内部4.5h测试集评估,提供了更硬的域间跨语言条件.

blocks.en:
We train models on BPE and phoneme alphabets.
The LibriSpeech BPE vocabulary contains 185 labels including blank while the end-of-word (EOW) augmented phoneme vocabulary contains 80 labels including blank.
The Loquacious setup uses BPE / EOW -phoneme vocabularies of 184/80 labels including blank.
On the Spanish task, we use a vocabulary of 63 EOW -phoneme labels.
blocks.zh:
我们用BPE和电话字母表训练模型
LibriSpeech BPE词汇包含185个包括空白的标签,而词尾(EOW)增强的电话me词汇包含80个包括空白的标签.
Loquacious 设置使用 BPE / EOW - phoneme 词汇 184/80 标签包括空白.
在西班牙的任务上,我们使用63个EOW的词汇-打通我的标签.

blocks.en:
For acoustic features, we extract 80-dimensional log-mel features from the 16kHz LibriSpeech and Loquacious data, and 60-dimensional log-mel features from the 8kHz Spanish data.
The features are passed through a convolutional front-end and subsampled to a step-size of 40 ms.
Afterwards, they are processed by a Conformer [ 25 ] encoder with 12 layers for LibriSpeech and Loquacious, and 16 layers for Spanish.
The transducer models additionally use a 2-layer feed-forward prediction network for the limited history and a 1-layer feed-forward joiner network.
blocks.zh:
对于声学特征,我们从16kHz LibriSpeech和Loquacious数据中提取出80-维log-mel特征,从8kHz西班牙数据中提取出60-维log-mel特征.
其特征通过相生前端并被分样为相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相相相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相相接相接相接相接相相接相接相相接相接相相接相相接相接相接相相相接相相相接相接相相相相相接相相相相相相接相接相相相接相相相相相相
之后,它们由Conformer [25] 编码器处理,LibriSpeech和Loquaccily有12层,而西班牙有16层。
转录器模型还额外使用2层向导预测网络,用于有限历史和1层向导接通网络.

blocks.en:
Each LibriSpeech model is trained for 100 epochs, each Loquacious model for 40 epochs, and the Spanish model for 60 epochs.
All models use a One-Cycle Learning Rate (OCLR) [ 26 ] schedule and apply SpecAugment [ 27 ] , speed perturbation [ 28 ] , dropout, and weight decay for regularization.
blocks.zh:
每个LibriSpeech模型为100个纪元所训练,每个纪元为40个纪元所训练,西班牙模型为60个纪元所训练.
所有型号都采用单循环学习率(OCLR)[26]表并应用SpecAugment [27],速度扰动 [28],辍学,体重衰减等规范化.

blocks.en:
For word-level LM experiments, we apply a 4-gram LM ; for LibriSpeech, this is the official 4-gram LM , for Loquacious, this is the 4-gram LM setup described in [ 29 ] , and for Spanish, it is trained on in-house data.
On LibriSpeech, we additionally present results with a small 2-layer Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) [ 30 ] LM with 55M parameters at the BPE level and larger 96-layer Transformer LMs at BPE and word level with around 300M and 430M parameters respectively [ 31 ] .
blocks.zh:
对于单词级LM实验,我们应用了4克的LM;对于LibriSpeech来说,这是官方的4克的LM,对于Loquacious来说,这是[29]中描述的4克的LM设置,对于西班牙语来说,它是内部数据的培训.
在"LibriSpeech"上,我们额外呈现了2层小长短存储器(LSTM)[30]LM的结果,其中BPE级有55M参数,而BPE和单词级分别有约300M和430M参数的更大的96层变压器LMs[31].

blocks.en: IV Search Strategies
blocks.zh: 四. 搜索战略

blocks.en: TABLE I: WER and RTF results on LibriSpeech for different models given various search conditions and LM combinations.
blocks.zh: 表一:基于不同搜索条件和LM组合的不同模型,WER和RTF在LibriSpeech上的结果.

blocks.en: TABLE II: WER and RTF results on Loquacious for different models given various search conditions and LM combinations.
blocks.zh: 表二:基于不同的搜索条件和LM组合,WER和RTF对不同模型的Loquacious结果.

blocks.en:
Table I shows WER and search RTF results for the LibriSpeech models under different search conditions and LM integrations.
The search RTF only measures the computational speed of the search process, which includes hypothesis extension, predictor and joiner forwarding for transducer, LM forwarding, pruning and bookkeeping but excludes the encoder forwarding.
It is measured with all neural components (i.e., neural LMs and transducer predictor and joiner) running on an A10 GPU while the search logic and 4-gram LM run on CPU (note: the encoder RTF on an A10 is about 3.0 × 10 − 3 3.0\times 10^{-3} ).
The presented results cover decoding with no external LM , subword-level neural LSTM or Transformer LM integration, and word-level Transformer- LM or 4-gram integration.
Lexicon constraints improve CTC without an external LM (from 7.0/7.1% to 6.5/6.6% WER ) and have little effect for the transducer.
All external- LM combinations outperform the standalone ASR models by a good margin, with the best setup reaching 3.8/4.2% WER .
Overall, the word-level Transformer LM gives the best WER , while the 4-gram and subword-level LSTM LMs provide decent accuracy at much higher speed.
The subword-level Transformer LM is expensive in terms of execution time because it needs to score every (non-blank) subword extension, while not improving WER over the word-level Transformer LM which only needs to be forwarded at word ends.
The subword-level LSTM LM slightly improves over the 4-gram LM , but is also slower; combining the LSTM and 4-gram LMs gives results similar to the LSTM alone.
A natural direction for future work is to extend this comparison to larger ASR models trained on more data, where integration of external LMs may have lower impact.
blocks.zh:
表一显示不同搜索条件和LM集成下LibriSpeech模型的WER和搜索RTF结果.
搜索RTF只测量了搜索过程的计算速度,包括假想扩展,预测器和加载器转发给转录器,LM转发,运行和记账,但不包括编码器转发.
它用所有神经元件(即神经LM和转录器预测和加入器)在A10 GPU上运行时进行测量,而搜索逻辑和4克LM运行在CPU上(注:A10上的编码器RTF大约为3.0×10−3 3.0\times 10×3}).
所呈现的结果涵盖了没有外部LM的解码,子词层神经LSTM或变形器LM集成,以及词层变形器-LM或4克集成.
无外源LM(从7.0/7.1%到6.5/6.6%的WER)的Lexicon约束改进了CTC,对转录器影响不大.
所有外部- LM 组合都以良好的比分超过独立的 ASR 模型,最佳设置达到 3.8/4.2% WER .
总体而言,单词级变形器LM给出了最好的WER. 而4克和子词级的LSTM LMs以更高的速度提供了体面的精度.
子词级变形器 LM在执行时间上是昂贵的,因为它需要给每个(非空白)子字扩展打分,同时不比单词级变换器LM改进WER,而单词级变换器LM只需要在词尾上转发.
子字级的LSTM LM比4克的LM稍有改进,但也较慢;将LSTM和4克的LM合并后,只给出了类似LSTM的结果.
今后工作的一个自然方向是将这一比较扩大到接受更多数据培训的较大的ASR模型,在这种模型中,外部遗留物的整合可能影响较小。

blocks.en:
The phoneme CTC model is slightly worse than BPE CTC with a 4-gram LM (5.5/5.7% vs. 5.2/5.6%) and on par with the Transformer LM .
Search without a lexicon and word- LM is not applicable to phoneme models since phonetically equivalent words cannot be distinguished.
The transducer outperforms the CTC models, especially when no lexicon or LM is present (6.0/5.9% vs. 7.0/7.1% WER ) and remains better by between 0.3% to 0.7% absolute WER in all other conditions.
Compared to CTC , transducer search is much slower without LM or with only a 4-gram LM , but the gap shrinks with a neural LM because LM forwarding makes up a large part of the search cost.
blocks.zh:
电话式CTC型号略逊于4克LM(5.5/5.7%对5.2/5.6%)并和变形器LM(变形器LM)相当的BPE CTC型号.
没有词汇和单词的搜索-LM不适用于电话模式,因为口语等同词无法区分.
转录器的性能优于四氯化碳模型,特别是在没有词汇或LM(6.0/5.9%对7.0/7.1%WER)存在的情况下,在所有其他条件下,转录器的性能仍好于0.3%至0.7%的绝对WER。
相较于CTC,没有LM或只有4克LM的转录器搜索速度要慢得多,但间隙会用神经LM收缩,因为LM转发占了搜索成本的一大部分.

blocks.en: Table II reports the same core search conditions without neural LMs on Loquacious, providing evidence on a public heterogeneous dataset beyond LibriSpeech.
blocks.zh: 表二报告了同样的核心搜索条件,没有神经元LMs在Loquacious上,提供了LibriSpeech以外的公共多样性数据集的证据.

blocks.zh: V 搜索空间复杂度

blocks.zh: 表四:在LibriSpeech dev-other上使用BPE转录器Lexicon-受约束搜索+单词级变换器LM进行不同推算参数的WER和假想计数统计.

blocks.en:
We first investigate the relation between pruning parameters, search space size, and recognition performance.
To optimize the pruning parameters, we first set a very large maximum beam-size B B while tuning the score thresholds and then decrease B B until performance starts to degrade. Tables III and IV show LibriSpeech lexicon-constrained BPE CTC and BPE transducer search with a word-level Transformer LM .
Search errors count segments that were transcribed incorrectly although the ground-truth transcription has a better score than the recognized one, i.e., the ground-truth was erroneously pruned away during search.
The tables also include percentile statistics of the within-word hypothesis counts at each search step.
blocks.zh:
我们首先调查了探测参数、搜索空间大小和识别性能之间的关系。
为了优化打分参数,我们首先设定了非常大的最大横梁尺寸B B,同时调整分数阈值,再降低B B,直到性能开始退化. 表三和表四显示 LibriSpeech 语法受约束的 BPE CTC 和 BPE 转录器的搜索,并带有单词级变换器 LM.
搜索错误计数错误地转录的片段,尽管地面真实记录的分数优于公认的分数,也就是说,地面真实记录在搜索过程中被错误地冲走。
这些表格还包括每个搜索步骤中词内假设数的百分数统计。

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Illustrative number of active within-word hypotheses at each search step for a selected LibriSpeech dev-other utterance with BPE CTC /transducer using lexicon-constrained search including a word-level 4-gram LM .
blocks.zh: 发相. 1: 使用词汇约束的搜索器,包括一个4克LM的单词级搜索器,对选定的 LibriSpeech ev-other 语句使用 BPE CTC / 递出器的每个搜索步骤的活字内假说编号。

blocks.en:
The p50 value shows that the median active hypothesis set is small while the p90 and p99 statistics show that in some rare difficult regions the signal causes locally increased hypothesis counts.
This effect is visualized in Figure 1 which shows the hypothesis count by timestep for a selected utterance with a CTC and transducer model.
The search space stays small for most search steps and exhibits one large temporary peak between steps 300 and 400.
blocks.zh:
p50值显示中位活性假说集很小,而p90和p99统计显示,在一些罕见的困难地区,信号导致局部增加假说数.
图1可视化了这种效果,图1显示用CTC和转录器模型的选定语句的假想数。
搜索空间对大多数搜索步骤来说仍然很小,并显示一个300至400步之间的大临时高峰.

blocks.en:
Table V reports the corresponding analysis for Loquacious with BPE transducer decoding and a word 4-gram LM .
Overall, the hypothesis counts are lower on Loquacious.
This effect can be explained by the fact that the experiments on Loquacious only use a 4-gram LM and a much lower LM scale (see Table X ).
Since the 4-gram only relies on a three-word history, the recombination step can recombine many more hypotheses and with the low LM scale, score jumps from the LM score contributions are much smaller and need a lower score threshold to cover for them.
Still, the same non-uniform behavior can be observed on this dataset: the median active set remains small, while p99 reflects rare high-complexity regions and is comparatively much higher.
blocks.zh:
表五报告了Loquacious的相应分析,包括BPE转录器解码和4克LM。
总的来说,假设数低于Loquacious。
之所以产生这种效应,是因为Loquacious上的实验只使用4克LM和更低的LM尺度(见表十)。
由于"4克"只依靠"三字历史",重组步骤可以再接再励更多的假说,而LM尺度也较低,因此从LM分数贡献中分数跳出要小得多,需要更低的分数阈值来覆盖.
尽管如此,也可以在这个数据集中观察到同样的非统一行为:中位活性集仍然很小,而p99则反映了稀有的高复杂度区域,相对更高.

blocks.en:
To test more difficult acoustic conditions, we collected similar statistics for a phoneme CTC model on the in-house Spanish 8kHz telephony test set, as shown in Table VI .
This task has a much higher WER and a low hypothesis count in the tens is not nearly enough to reach full performance in this case.
Even at the median, several hundred hypotheses are required and the p90 and p99 values go into the thousands in order to reach optimal performance.
blocks.zh:
为了测试更困难的声学条件,我们收集了内部西班牙8kHz电话测试集上电话式CTC模型的类似统计数据,见表六。
这项任务的WER值要高得多,而数十人的假设数低,这几乎不足以达到本案的全部性能.
即便在中位数,也需要几百个假设,而p90和p99值会进入上千个,以便达到最佳性能.

blocks.en:
These results confirm that small fixed beams are insufficient when model uncertainty is higher and when external LM contribution makes up a large part of the score.
Dynamic pruning adapts to the model uncertainty and LM score contributions and keeps the hypothesis counts comparatively low in the median.
blocks.zh:
这些结果证实,当模型不确定性较高,且外部LM贡献占得分的大部分时,小的固定束是不够的.
动态推算适应了模型不确定性和LM分数贡献,使假设计数在中位数中相对较低.

blocks.en: VI Search Efficiency
blocks.zh: 六 搜索效率

blocks.en:
Search efficiency is tied to the size of the active search space.
We compare fixed max-beam pruning with dynamic score-threshold pruning while preserving the WER .
For each max-beam size B ASR B_{\mathrm{ASR}} , the fixed baseline uses only max-beam pruning while the dynamic variant additionally performs score-threshold pruning with the tightest possible thresholds that do not degrade the WER .
We report the relative search RTF reduction when switching from fixed to dynamic pruning in percent: RTF reduction [ % ] = 100 ⋅ ( 1 − RTF dynamic RTF fixed ) . \mathrm{RTF\ reduction}\left[\%\right]=100\cdot\left(1-\frac{\mathrm{RTF}_{\mathrm{dynamic}}}{\mathrm{RTF}_{\mathrm{fixed}}}\right). (7)

blocks.en:
Figures 2 and 3 contrast score-based pruning with pure max-beam pruning for LibriSpeech BPE transducer search with subword and word LMs .
In both cases, dynamic pruning achieves the same WERs at much faster inference times, especially at higher beam sizes.
With dynamic pruning, the RTF only increases marginally while fixed beam pruning quickly becomes very expensive.
For the smaller LSTM LM the search times are faster than with the larger Transformer LM but the relative difference between fixed and dynamic pruning is still clear. Figure 4 shows the same effect on Spanish telephony with a 4-gram LM .

blocks.en:
In Table IX we summarize the reduction in average hypothesis count and search RTF for different ASR models and external LMs on all three datasets.
When no external LM is used, greedy search already gives optimal results and dynamic pruning provides no advantage in this case.
For all experiments with external LM , however, dynamic pruning provides significant efficiency improvements to reach the same WER .
The average hypothesis count and search RTF are often reduced by around an order of magnitude.
The relative RTF reduction is largest for CTC and 4-gram LM setups because their search cost is dominated by hypothesis expansion and CPU-side bookkeeping, while transducer prediction/joiner networks and neural LMs use batched GPU computations which do not scale linearly with the active set.
blocks.zh:
在表九中,我们总结了平均假设数的减少情况,并在所有三个数据集上搜索不同ASR模型和外部LM。
当没有使用外部LM时,贪婪的搜索已经给出了最佳结果,而动态搜索在这种情况下没有优势.
然而,对于所有使用外部LM的实验来说,动态穿透提供了显著的效率提高,可以达到相同的WER.
平均假说计数和搜索RTF往往会减少大约一个数量级.
相对的RTF减少量对于CTC和4克LM设置来说最大,因为其搜索成本以假说扩展和CPU侧记为主,而转录器预测/连接器网络和神经LMs则使用批量的GPU计算,这些计算不与活性集进行线性缩放.

blocks.en: VII Conclusions
blocks.zh: 页:1 结论

blocks.en:
We presented a systematic comparison of search strategies for time-synchronous BPE - and phoneme-based CTC and monotonic neural transducer models in E2E ASR .
Comparisons of WER and RTF show that dynamic score-based pruning and external LM combination remain relevant for decoding with modern E2E ASR models.
We have seen that typically, these models operate with a low active hypothesis count for the majority of search steps but spike to hundreds or thousands of hypotheses in rare difficult regions.
This behavior is verified on the public LibriSpeech task as well as the more heterogeneous public Loquacious task and a more difficult in-house telephony dataset.
blocks.zh:
我们提供了E2E ASR中基于电话的CTC和单声道神经传导模型搜索策略的系统比较。
对WER和RTF的比较表明,动态计分的普鲁能和外部LM组合仍然与现代E2E ASR模型的解码相关.
我们看到,这些模型的运作通常以低活性假说计算大多数搜索步骤,但在罕见的困难地区却高达上百或上千个假说。
这种行为通过公开LibriSpeech任务以及更加多样的公共Loquacous任务和更加困难的内部电话数据集加以核实。

blocks.en:
The fixed-vs-dynamic pruning experiments show that dynamic pruning can preserve WER while reducing search RTF by adapting the active hypothesis set to local uncertainty, especially with external LMs where low fixed-size beams are insufficient for optimal performance.
We provide tuned decoding parameters and open source implementations for reproducibility.
blocks.zh:
固定vs-动力推跑实验显示,动态推跑可以通过使活性假说集适应局部不确定性来降低搜索RTF的同时保留WER,特别是外部LM,低固定尺寸的束不足以达到最佳性能.
我们提供调制解码参数和开源执行,以便复制。

blocks.en: This study is limited to time-synchronous CTC and transducer search; label-synchronous and streaming decoding require some fundamentally different analysis and remain future work.
blocks.zh: 这项研究仅限于时间同步的CTC和转录器搜索;标签同步和流码解码需要一些根本不同的分析并保持未来的工作.

blocks.en: Overall, our results suggest that external LM integration and dynamic pruning are underutilized in modern E2E ASR applications.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,我们的结果表明,在现代E2E ASR应用中,外部LM集成和活性穿孔利用不足.
